name: Customer Luv Surveys
description:
Customer Luv Surveys asks your buyers one question at a time on the Shopify thank-you page, the moment they are most likely to answer — then turns those answers into attribution you can act on.

Ask Claude to build a survey by describing it: "ask new customers how they found us, then offer 15% off their next order." Claude interviews you the way a good consultant would, drafts the questions, and shows you the whole thing before anything goes live. Ask it what the answers mean — which channel sends your highest-value buyers, which question is losing people, what changed this month — and it reads your real response data to answer.

It can also run the parts merchants usually postpone: targeting sets to specific products, checking a keyword actually matches your catalog before you trust it, linting your setup for coverage gaps and wording drift that quietly splits your analytics, and connecting Klaviyo so answers land on customer profiles for segments and flows.

Nothing reaches a customer without your say-so. Question sets are always created switched OFF. To publish one, Claude has to come back, show you exactly what it plans to turn on, and get a yes in the chat first — one yes can cover a batch. It refuses to publish anything half-built, such as a free gift reward with no product chosen. Read-only questions answer instantly; permanent deletion always asks.

Requires a Shopify store with the Customer Luv Surveys app installed. Free plan available.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Customer Luv Surveys to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Customer Luv Surveys to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.customerluv.app/mcp/surveys. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Customer Luv Surveys MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Customer Luv Surveys lists 16 MCP tools, including connect_klaviyo_for_surveys, create_question_set, delete_question_set, get_question_set, get_survey_analytics, get_survey_answers, get_survey_guide, get_survey_setup_status, lint_question_sets, list_question_sets, list_survey_reward_codes, and move_question_set.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Customer Luv Surveys?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Customer Luv Surveys in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.

_published_faq.name: Does Customer Luv Surveys MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Customer Luv Surveys requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Customer Luv Surveys is developed by Customer Luv. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
